design_rationale:
WORKLOG - task 0 of guest_protection_desk (Keyturn Guest Protection Plan)

STEP 0 - DRAW, ASSET LEDGER AND CLAIM
draw_counts.py env/env_0015_car_sharing_marketplace/tasks/guest_protection_desk --task 0 printed
{"task": 0, "key": "env_0015_car_sharing_marketplace/guest_protection_desk/0", "prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3, "factor_counts": [4, 6, 4]}.
The tree therefore has exactly two prerequisite problems besides the root, and the three computations carry
4, 6 and 4 declared factors as a multiset. Assigned: the level change difference takes 6, the additional
driver charge 4, the young-driver surcharge 4.
Nothing was occupied before this task: it is the first of two. Task 1 draws
{"task": 1, "prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [5, 4]}, so two policies must be left
free for it with a root and one prerequisite of their own. This task claims three of the difficulty's five
policies: guestplan_ext_additional_driver_charge, guestplan_ext_young_driver_surcharge and
guestplan_ext_level_change_difference, with their three task tools. Left for task 1: the daily protection fee
itself (guestplan_protection_fee_charged on a fresh election) and the guest's own choice of level
(guestplan_election_confirmed) - a load-bearing root and prerequisite that this task does not touch, since this
task's election is already active on a level chosen a month ago and its daily fee line already stands.
Only two writes in this product are the guest's own, choosing a protection level and declaring an additional
driver; this task takes the second and leaves the first to task 1, so both trees can carry an owner=user problem.

DESIGN THESIS
Surface goal: a guest part-way through a two-month booking rang because the request she lodged this morning to
move her protection up a level has not been priced. Scored core parameter: difference_amount on that move.
Between the goal and that number the policy puts two hops that the customer never mentions. The level change
policy's own rule says the difference is worked out only after the protection already charged for the level
first held stands complete, the young-driver surcharge included; the records show no surcharge line, so the
surcharge must be raised first. The surcharge policy's own rule says the surcharge is not fixed before the
charge lines carry the fee due for every additional driver declared on the election; the election declares one
additional driver and no driver line stands, so the driver must be taken onto the cover first - and that is the
guest's own act, handed to her. Breadth: each of the three numbers is composed from four to six ladders reading
the guest's twelve-month trip ledger in another difficulty, the election's own charge ledger, the reserved
period of the trip, the daily rate locked in at confirmation and the approved change request.
The core parameter is never named by the customer: she says only move up to the better cover for the rest of my
trip, and tell me what it comes to. No single current-value lookup answers it.

CHECK CARD 1 - BASE INVARIANTS
Write subject guestplan_secondary_driver_charged and guestplan_protection_fee_charged: the only base policy
whose subject intersects them is guestplan_evt_fee_charging, whose single gate is election_chosen_before_charging,
'A fee line is posted only while the election is in the elected or active state, since a quote that was never
chosen is never charged.' Authority system_record, timing pre_action, correlation key
guestplan_elections.election_id bound to the action argument election_id. At frozen_time the election
ca8e9c0b-ee7b-4e02-a45f-2dca364312f9 is active, so the gate holds for both writes; had it still been quoted,
neither line could be raised at all. No time gate on this subject, so no anchor question arises.
Write subject guestplan_level_change_charged: the only governing base policy is guestplan_level_change, whose
single gate is the time gate change_decision_window, 'A change is priced only where the request is recorded no
later than the change decision window counted forward from the moment the guest asked for it.' Starting business
event: the request is recorded. Authoritative anchor: guestplan_change_requests.requested_at. Clock: frozen_time.
Duration source: params.change_decision_window_hours, four hours on the standard level the election is on. Unit:
elapsed_hours. Counting rule, verbatim: 'The decision window is counted in whole elapsed hours from the timestamp
on the change request, never in calendar days, and an hour counts only once it has fully elapsed.' Direction:
not_after. Boundary: inclusive. Positive case: requested_at 2026-04-18 12:05:00 CDT, frozen_time 2026-04-18
15:20:00 CDT, three hours and fifteen minutes elapsed, inside four. Boundary: at 16:05:00 exactly four whole
hours have elapsed and the inclusive boundary still admits the pricing. Negative case: at 16:06 the window is
past and the correct handling is to leave the move unpriced. The seeded requested_at was chosen for that margin
rather than for convenience.
Inherited and untouched: guestplan_evt_fee_charging keeps its charged-days floor, its billing point and its
floor/ceiling sentence except where overwrite names one clause; guestplan_level_change keeps its rule that a
change is priced only once approved, that moving up mid-trip is open only on the levels that allow it (the
standard level allows it), and that cover after a change is the new level's for the rest of the trip.

CHECK CARD 2 - BUSINESS OBJECT
Narrowest object: election ca8e9c0b-ee7b-4e02-a45f-2dca364312f9, the single protection election attached to
booking 60255f0b-8424-434a-9221-9ffa8d027172, the guest's only live trip. Correlation key: election_id on every
protection line, plus source_charge_id naming the exact fee line a derived line is measured against. Rows
entering the aggregates: only protection lines carrying that election_id, narrowed by charge_basis -
daily_protection_fee for the fee already charged, secondary_driver_fee for the driver fees,
young_driver_protection_surcharge for the loading, level_upgrade_difference for an earlier move. Rows excluded:
the guest's other three bookings and their eight trip charge lines never enter a protection aggregate; they are
read only as the twelve-month trip ledger the ladders test, where the window itself excludes the 2025-02, 2025-03
rows. Nothing on this election has been settled, reversed or compensated, so no existing credit has to be netted.
The derived lines this task writes each carry source_charge_id = 9ddc3367-1d1a-41ad-819b-8251b2942819, the
original daily protection fee line, rather than leaning on election_id alone.

CHECK CARD 3 - PROBLEM TREE
Root: guestplan_ext_level_change_difference (the move the customer asks about).
Edge 1: guestplan_ext_level_change_difference depends on guestplan_ext_young_driver_surcharge.
  kind value_input; gate surcharge_lines_total; form state.
  Prerequisite sentence, verbatim from the blocked policy's own rule: 'The difference due on a move of level is
  worked out only after the protection already charged on the election for the level first held stands complete,
  the young-driver surcharge included.'
  Four-point test: (1) the ordering connective is 'only after', joining this policy's own result (the difference
  due on a move of level) to what it waits on; the affirmative direction is what the desk that settles a charge
  would use - a charge is fixed only after what it rests on is complete. Rewritten in the negated direction it
  reads 'the difference due on a move of level is not worked out until the protection already charged on the
  election for the level first held stands complete, the young-driver surcharge included' - same result, same
  waited-on state, same scope, nothing added, dropped or split. (2) The XX side is a record-visible state: the
  protection charged on the election, which the charge lines show, with the young-driver surcharge among them.
  (3) It names no tool, no policy id and no code token. (4) Strength and scope are exactly the edge's condition:
  a hard 'only after', and the closed item named is the young-driver surcharge.
  Exactly one write of this difficulty brings that state about: only guestplan_ext_young_driver_surcharge
  computes and books a young-driver protection surcharge line, so a reader who checks the charge lines, sees no
  such line and reads the other policies' rules reaches that problem and no other.
  Handling-time state (condition): the election's charge lines carry the young-driver surcharge owed on the
  protection for the level first held. Resolving action: post_young_driver_surcharge_f46febb9, owner agent.
  False at the opening: initial_state.guestplan_charges.9ddc3367-1d1a-41ad-819b-8251b2942819.charge_basis is
  daily_protection_fee and it is the only protection line on the election, so no surcharge line stands;
  initial_state.guestplan_elections.ca8e9c0b-ee7b-4e02-a45f-2dca364312f9.protection_fee_balance_due is 1560.00,
  the fee line alone.
Edge 2: guestplan_ext_young_driver_surcharge depends on guestplan_ext_additional_driver_charge.
  kind value_input; gate driver_lines_total; form state.
  Prerequisite sentence, verbatim from the blocked policy's own rule: 'The young-driver surcharge on a trip is
  not fixed before the election's charge lines carry the fee due for every additional driver declared on it.'
  Four-point test: (1) the connective is 'not ... before', the negated direction, which is how the desk states a
  loading it will not yet fix; rewritten affirmatively it reads 'the young-driver surcharge on a trip is fixed
  only after the election's charge lines carry the fee due for every additional driver declared on it' - the
  exact contrapositive, same result, same waited-on state, same quantifier 'every additional driver declared on
  it', and it negates the whole condition rather than listing failure cases. (2) The XX side is a record-visible
  state: a charge line on the election carrying the fee due for each declared additional driver. (3) No tool,
  policy id or code token. (4) The scope is the open set 'every additional driver declared on it', stated as open,
  which is exactly the edge's condition.
  Exactly one write of this difficulty brings that state about: only guestplan_ext_additional_driver_charge
  computes and books an additional driver fee line.
  Handling-time state (condition): the election's charge lines carry a line charging the additional driver fee
  for every additional driver the election declares. Resolving action: declare_additional_driver_a214c8dd,
  owner user - putting a driver on her own cover is the guest's own decision, handed to her by the desk.
  False at the opening:
  initial_state.guestplan_elections.ca8e9c0b-ee7b-4e02-a45f-2dca364312f9.declared_secondary_driver_count is 1
  while initial_state.guestplan_charges.9ddc3367-1d1a-41ad-819b-8251b2942819.charge_basis is daily_protection_fee
  and is the only protection line, so nothing charges for that declared driver.
Derivation, edge by edge: the reader of the level change rule learns the difference waits on the protection
charged for the level first held being complete with the young-driver surcharge in it; the charge lookup shows
one line on the daily protection fee basis and nothing else; the only rule in the charter that books a
young-driver protection surcharge is the young-driver surcharge policy, whose own rule says what it books; so the
one action is to raise that surcharge. Standing at that rule, the reader learns it is not fixed before every
declared additional driver stands charged; the election declares one and the charge lines carry no additional
driver fee; the only rule that books an additional driver fee is the additional driver charge policy; so the one
action is to take that driver onto the cover, and because that policy's action is the guest's own, the desk
unlocks it and hands it over. Each hop admits exactly one reading.
Topological order: guestplan_ext_additional_driver_charge, guestplan_ext_young_driver_surcharge,
guestplan_ext_level_change_difference. The tree is a chain, so there are no parallel edges to reorder and no
commutation argument is needed; the writes cannot be swapped because the surcharge base counts the driver line
and the credit counts the surcharge line.
Per-edge deletion sensitivity, from the Step 5 run:
  skip the surcharge write -> the level change's protection_charged falls from 1900.89 to 1596.50, its
  credit_for_days_left from 1140.534 to 957.90 and difference_amount from 206.32 to 388.96.
  skip the additional driver write -> the surcharge's base falls from 1596.50 to 1560.00 and surcharge_amount
  from 304.39 to 298.00; the level change's party step would also fall from 30.00 to nil.
user_scenario mentions no prerequisite problem; the tool layer validates none. Both are argued in full in
prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint and prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block.

STEP 1 - POLICIES
Three extended policies were written to guestplan.extended.yaml, each layering calculation on base and each
declaring its overwrite clause by clause.
guestplan_ext_additional_driver_charge (state_due; subject guestplan_secondary_driver_charged; computes
driver_fee_amount; target declare_additional_driver_a214c8dd, owner user). base_policy_refs
[guestplan_evt_fee_charging] - the only base policy governing that subject. overwrite names one clause:
'Additional drivers are charged the level's additional driver fee once each for the whole trip, not once for each
day, and a level that carries no additional driver fee charges nothing however many drivers are approved.',
replaced by the policy's own closing sentence. The gate sentence is not quoted, so
election_chosen_before_charging stays in force and is inherited into the contract. Trigger: with nobody calling,
a declared driver who is charged nothing is money the marketplace is owed at month end, so state_due.
guestplan_ext_young_driver_surcharge (state_due; subject guestplan_protection_fee_charged; computes
surcharge_amount; target post_young_driver_surcharge_f46febb9, owner agent). Same base lineage and same
inherited gate. overwrite names 'A driver under the young-driver threshold pays the level's protection surcharge
on the fee, and the surcharge is posted as its own line so that it can be reversed on its own.'
guestplan_ext_level_change_difference (on_request; subject guestplan_level_change_charged; computes
difference_amount; target price_level_change_f4995b0a, owner agent). Its domain is a move UP: the rule's opening
sentence scopes it to a guest who moves up to a protection level of higher rank than the one first held, so base's
downgrade-credit sentence governs a move down and is not in conflict with anything this policy says. The tool
matches that scope, writing a line on the level upgrade difference basis for the upgraded stretch of the trip. base_policy_refs [guestplan_level_change,
guestplan_evt_fee_charging] - the first governs the subject, the second is the genuine input lineage of the
level figures the difference is built from. overwrite names two clauses of guestplan_level_change, the
remaining-whole-days difference sentence and the mid-trip change fee sentence. Trigger: a quote that arises only
because the guest asks, so on_request.
Each (target_tool, computes) pair is claimed once. Each policy declares cross_category [trips], matched exactly
by its compute and by inputs.cross_category, and each writes only guestplan tables.

Forward references rule -> compute_basis -> compute: every binding that reads the world, aggregates, chooses,
caps or rounds carries a verbatim rule sentence in compute_basis - the level lookups quote the baseline fee
sentence, the ladder bindings quote their own tier sentences, the aggregate bindings quote the sentence naming
the stretch of ledger they read, and each result binding quotes the closing 'therefore' sentence that fixes the
order of operations and the single rounding at the end.
Reverse sweep compute -> rule: every load-bearing sentence of each rule is claimed. The twelve-month windows in
the seat rate, the surcharge percentage and the young-driver step sentences correspond to within_months=12 on
XSUM and XCOUNT with date_field='charge_date'; 'the protection already charged' corresponds to a SUM
over guestplan_charges on the daily protection fee basis netted against a SUM on the protection refund basis,
exactly as each rule defines it; 'held to the ceiling' corresponds to MN; 'reaches ... but not ...'
corresponds to the ternary chains; 'rounded to two decimal places only once the whole of it has been worked out'
corresponds to the single RND wrapping the whole result and nowhere else; 'counted from the day the move is
priced to the last reserved day of the trip, the day the move is priced included' corresponds to
DAYS(NOW, trip_last_day) + 1. No filter appears in an expression that the quoted sentence does not carry.
Semantic choices pinned in prose rather than left to a summary word: the additional driver rule states that the
level's fee is taken at the seat rate for the seat days out of the covered days and that the band uplift and the
cover load are added to that figure, so the rate acts on the prorated fee and not on the uplifted total; the
surcharge rule states that the percentage is taken on the base, then held to the ceiling, then the trip step is
added to the capped figure, so the step is outside the cap; the level change rule states that the discount
reduces the cost of the level moved to, that the credit is then subtracted, and that the three steps are added
to that figure in turn, so the discount never touches the credit or the steps. Every rule states that rounding
happens once, at the end.

STEP 2 - TOOLS
declare_additional_driver_a214c8dd (owner user, rw write). User: the guest. Object: her protection election.
Atomic action: one additional driver taken onto the cover for the trip. Change: one new protection line on the
election carrying event type guestplan_secondary_driver_charged and basis secondary_driver_fee, with the fee and
the seat days, raising the protection fee she owes. Observable: the receipt naming the new line, the fee to two
decimals and the whole number of days. Its parameters are only what the guest holds before acting - the
references the desk reads out to her and the figures the desk has worked out and told her; the line reference is
a return, never a parameter.
post_young_driver_surcharge_f46febb9 (owner agent, rw write). Object: the same election. Atomic action: the
young-driver loading raised as its own line against a named fee line. Change: one protection line with basis
young_driver_protection_surcharge, days_covered fixed at nil inside the tool because the line is flat. Receipt:
the new line reference, the amount and the fee line it was measured against.
price_level_change_f4995b0a (owner agent, rw write). Object: the same election and the approved change request.
Atomic action: the approved move priced. Change: one protection line with basis level_upgrade_difference and
coverage segment upgraded, plus the same figure written back as the quoted difference on the request. Receipt:
the difference line reference, the amount, the days it was priced on and the request it settles.
None of the three aggregates history, judges eligibility or checks a prerequisite; each is a bare ctx.create
(plus one ctx.update on the register) over the arguments as given.
check_task_tools.py passed on all three at every revision.

STEP 3 - SEED
18 rows, all uuid4, no dangling foreign key, closure equal to initial_state (replay reports clos=18 init=18
match=True).
customers: the guest Danica Zielinski, born 2002-03-14 so twenty-four on the trip's first day and under the
marketplace's young-driver threshold of twenty-five, driver score 76 which clears the standard level's 70 and
the advantage level's 72; the host Elena Tremblay, who owns the listing. Remove the guest row and nothing can be
located or verified; remove the host row and the listing has no owner.
listings_vehicles: one Toyota 4Runner valued at 41,800.00 in the premium class. It is read to confirm the level
moved to does not exclude the vehicle - the advantage level excludes no class and stops at 175,000.00. Remove it
and that check cannot be made.
trips_bookings: the live booking on the monthly plan, 2026-03-25 to 2026-05-23, 1440 reserved hours, daily rate
112.00 locked at confirmation, in progress; three earlier bookings that carry the twelve-month history. Remove
the live booking and the reserved period, the locked rate and the trip price for the days still to run all
vanish.
trips_charges: eight lines. 5241.60 base rate and 628.99 young-driver surcharge and 419.33 trip fee on
2026-03-20 for the live trip - the base rate is 112.00 x 60 x 0.78 under the monthly plan's 22 per cent discount
and the surcharge is that plan's 12 per cent of it, so the lines teach no arithmetic the charter does not
contain; 414.00 base rate on 2025-11-10 and 39.90 mileage overage on 2025-11-17 on the November trip; 2328.48
base rate on 2025-02-10 and 76.00 late return on 2025-03-07 on the February trip; 69.00 cancellation fee on
2025-03-05 on the trip the guest cancelled.
The near-misses are deliberate and all three ladders that read this ledger have one. Base rate inside twelve
months is 5,655.60, which sits between the returning-guest threshold of 3,000.00 and the established-guest
threshold of 7,500.00; counting the 2,328.48 line from 2025-02-10 as well would give 7,984.08 and push the seat
rate down a tier. The only cancellation fee stands on 2025-03-05, just outside the window; counting it would
drop the seat rate to the fall-through. The only late return stands on 2025-03-07, just outside the window;
counting it would send the surcharge percentage to the fall-through, the level's own 22 per cent. The mileage
overage on 2025-11-17 is inside the window and is what puts the guest on the watched-record tier rather than the
clean-record tier.
guestplan_elections: one election, active on the standard level since 2026-03-25, 60 covered days, 1,560.00
protection fee outstanding, one additional driver declared and no deductible. The declared count of one with no
driver line is the first prerequisite made false; the single fee line with no surcharge line is the second.
guestplan_charges: two lines. The daily protection fee posted 2026-03-18 for 60 days on the initial stretch was
raised at the standard level's ceiling of 1,600.00, and a 40.00 billing correction was returned against it on
2026-03-26 naming that line as its source, so the protection actually charged is 1,560.00 - which is what the
level's greater-of basis produces, 26.00 x 60 = 1,560.00 against 25 per cent of 5,241.60 = 1,310.40, inside the
26.00 floor and the 1,600.00 ceiling. The pair is a deliberate trap: an agent who reads the fee line and stops
carries 1,600.00 into the cover load, the surcharge base and the credit and gets all three figures wrong, while
the election's own outstanding protection fee of 1,560.00 corroborates the netted number. Remove either line and
the cover load, the surcharge base, the surcharge ceiling and the credit all change.
guestplan_change_requests: one request for the advantage level, approved, lodged 2026-04-18 12:05:00 CDT. It is
what names the level moved to, and its timestamp is what the decision window runs from.
No outcome stamp decides any tier: every ladder reads an aggregate, a date span or another product's ledger.
No cache field was set against its ledger in this task, so check_cache_diff has nothing to report and the
history difficulty rests on the twelve-month windows instead.
Automatic clauses reviewed: guestplan_lifecycle would expire a quote at the trip's start - this election is
already active, so nothing fires; guestplan_void would void an election whose trip fell away - the trip is in
progress; guestplan_evt_refund would arise only against a line already returned - none is. On the trips side the
bookings are settled or cancelled with balances that match their lines, so no trips obligation is lit that this
difficulty cannot carry.
Handling-time eligibility audit: at the moment of each write the election is active, so
election_chosen_before_charging holds for the driver line and the surcharge line; at the moment of the third
write the approved request is three hours and fifteen minutes old against a four-hour window, so
change_decision_window holds. On the opening world the root's own inputs are not yet what they must be, which is
precisely the design.

STEP 4 - PERSONA
Written in Danica's own voice: quick, cheerful, calling from a break between sets, no headings and no
conditional template. Volunteered at the opening: who she is, that she has had the car since 25 March and has it
until 23 May, that she lodged a change this morning and nothing has happened, and the request itself in her own
words - move up to the better cover for the rest of my trip, and tell me what it comes to - together with the
timing (now, on this call) and the authorisation boundary (the desk may act on its side; she will do in person
whatever has to come from her). Every one of those facts is entailed by the seed: the booking dates, the
in-progress state and the change request lodged at 12:05 on the handling date.
Given only when asked: her mobile 5127740318, her date of birth 2002-03-14, her licence number 53418627, her
ZIP 78745 and her email, one at a time. Explicit cannot-answer branches: any booking or internal reference (she
says it is all in the app and asks the agent to look it up) and any figure for what the cover or the change
should cost (she says she has no idea and will not guess), so the simulator never improvises and never supplies
a number gold uses.
Passive reactions, each triggered by something the agent says: she agrees the other person named on her booking
should be put on the cover properly only after the agent tells her he never was, and she runs that step herself
once it is handed to her; she accepts the age loading only after the agent explains it; she closes only after
the agent tells her the change has been priced and gives the figure. Her last reaction answers the last gold
action and asks for nothing beyond it - no document to send, no address, no statement.
Authority: every internal fact she touches is expressed as her own impression (nothing has happened, no price,
no confirmation), which the records bear out, and she never asserts a terminal state the system record
contradicts. She knows none of 36.50, 304.39 or 206.32 and cannot be drawn into naming any figure.

STEP 5 - VERIFICATION AND GT
The handling-time recomputation was run from the policies on disk and this seed, replaying the gold writes in
topological order with the real tools before each evaluation. Commands and output:
  .venv/bin/python skills/erl-task-instantiate/scripts/check_compute.py env/env_0015_car_sharing_marketplace/tasks/guest_protection_desk --task 0
  -> 0.json comps=3 fact=14 xfac=3 hist=7 brch=78 step=14 match=True ; COMPUTE OK
The three scored values, each on the world as it stands at its own step:
  driver_fee_amount 36.50 = 20.00 x 0.85 x 42 / 60 + 9.00 + a cover load percentage of 1.0 taken as a percentage of (1,600.00 - 40.00).
  surcharge_amount 304.39 = min(17.5 per cent of 1,596.50, 400.00) + 25.00 = 304.3875, rounded half up to the cent once at the end.
  difference_amount 206.32 = 1,411.20 x 0.88 - 1,140.534 + 20.00 + 55.00 + 30.00 = 206.322, rounded half up to the cent once at the end.
Factor sensitivity, every factor moving the result (recorded per computation in factor_sensitivity):
  additional driver: 38.60 / 41.60 / 27.50 / 20.90 against 36.50; all four baselines at once give 20.00.
  surcharge: 298.00 / 376.23 / 175.00 / 279.39 against 304.39; all four baselines at once give 150.00.
  level change: 168.31 / 410.86 / 375.67 / 186.32 / 151.32 / 176.32 against 206.32; all six at once give 432.00.
Every whole-baseline figure differs from gold, so an agent who finds only the computation document and none of
the factor documents computes a definite wrong number with no signal.
Prerequisite sensitivity, run separately: skipping the surcharge write gives 388.96 in place of 206.32;
skipping the driver write gives 298.00 in place of 304.39. Both edges bear weight.
Whole-input floors: forcing every cross-category read off changes each result, and zeroing the history
aggregates changes each result, both checked by the gate.
Only then were computations.expected and the gold arguments filled in. Every non-computed argument is a
reference read from a lookup return or a value the schema pins; argument_uniqueness_tracing carries an entry for
each, with the verbatim quotation of the sentence that pins it and the reason no second value is reachable.
Draft recomputation from the visible context alone: masking the extended yaml, compute, expected, gold and this
worklog, and working only from the prose the knowledge base will carry, the tool schemas, the rows the finders
return and the caller's actual lines, the same conclusion follows - the move may be priced because the approved
request is inside its four-hour window; the difference waits on the protection charged for the level first held
being complete with the young-driver surcharge in it, which the charge lines show it is not; the surcharge waits
on every declared additional driver standing charged, which the charge lines show it is not; so the order is the
driver, then the surcharge, then the difference, with the driver's step handed to the guest; and the three
figures follow from the ladders and the ledger to 36.50, 304.39 and 206.32. No second reading of any hop was
found.

STEP 6 - EVALUATION AND SCOPE
Eight read nodes precede the writes: the member lookup and the identity check; the election; the bookings; the
listing; the protection lines; the change request register; the guest's trip charge lines. The protection-line
read is what lets the agent see that no additional driver fee and no young-driver surcharge stand, which is how
both prerequisites are discovered; the trip charge read is what every cross-difficulty ladder rests on; the
booking read carries the reserved period and the locked daily rate. No read is duplicated and none feeds no
decision.
Write nodes follow the topological order: unlock and hand over the guest's own action, then the surcharge, then
the difference. Each write is one problem's target tool, called once.
Closure: charter_scope.extended_policies equals the set of computations.policy_id equals the problems of the
tree; required_documents repeats it verbatim in the same order; charter_scope.task_tools equals the gold tools
in first-use order. No extra write tool and no policy hangs outside the tree, and nothing calls the transfer to
a human representative.
Everything runs under one frozen_time, 2026-04-18 15:20:00 CDT; no step waits for a diagnosis, a payment to

The daily protection fee line was raised at the standard level's ceiling of 1,600.00, which is more than the level's greater-of basis produces for this trip: 60 charged days at the level's daily amount of 26.00 is 1,560.00, against 25 per cent of the trip price of 5,241.60 which is 1,310.40, so the larger of the two is 1,560.00, inside the level's floor of 26.00 and its ceiling of 1,600.00. The 40.00 difference was returned against this line on 2026-03-26 as a billing correction, which is why the election's outstanding protection fee is 1,560.00 and not 1,600.00. It was posted on 2026-03-18, the day the level was chosen, which is the standard level's billing point at booking, it covers the initial stretch of the trip and it carries no adjustment reason.

The refund line returns 40.00 against one identified earlier line, the daily protection fee raised at the level's ceiling, which it names as its source; it is the only refund standing against that line, so it is not a duplicate, and it returns less than the line took. It carries no days because it corrects an amount rather than a stretch of cover, it is dated after the line it corrects, and its ground is a billing correction rather than a shortened or cancelled trip.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Pull up the member profile of the caller from the mobile number she states, returning her member reference, licence details, date of birth and driving score.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Nothing about a protection election can be read or written until the account being discussed is identified; the member reference this returns keys every later lookup.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Record a passed in-session identity check on the caller from the two profile details she states, her mobile number and her date of birth.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: No money may move on the election before the caller is confirmed to be the member who holds it; two matching details are what the check requires.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the guest's protection election: the level held, the state of the cover, the covered days, the fee outstanding and how many additional drivers the election declares.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The level first held, the covered days and the declared additional driver count are inputs of all three computations, and the election reference keys every protection lookup and every write.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the guest's trip bookings, above all the live one behind the election: its reserved start and end dates, its state and the daily rate locked in at confirmation.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The reserved end date fixes the days still to run and the seat days, the reserved period fixes the whole months behind the trip step and the move discount, and the locked daily rate decides the band uplift, the young-driver move step and the trip price for the days still to run.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the listing the trip is on: its value class and the marketplace's current valuation of the vehicle.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: A level will not cover a vehicle above its exclusion ceiling or in one of its excluded value classes, so the level moved to has to be checked against this listing before the move is priced at all.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read every protection line standing on the election: what has been charged, on what basis, for how many days and against which stretch of the trip.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: These lines are the protection already charged: they feed the cover load, the surcharge base, the surcharge ceiling, the credit for the days still to run, the change fee and the party step, and they are also where the agent sees that no additional driver fee and no young-driver surcharge stand yet.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the request to move level standing on the election: the level asked for, how far the request has got and the moment it was lodged.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The approved request names the level moved to, which decides its daily amount, its share of the trip price and the basis it arrives at its fee on; the moment it was lodged is what the decision window is measured from.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the guest's own trip charge lines over her marketplace history: base rates, cancellation fees, late returns, mileage overages and young-driver surcharges, each with its date.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The base rate carried over the last twelve months and the absence of a cancellation fee in that time decide the seat rate; late returns and mileage overages in that window decide the surcharge percentage; a young-driver surcharge on the trip decides the young-driver move step.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the customer's own action for taking an additional driver onto the protection covering the trip and hand it to her.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Putting a driver on her own cover is the guest's decision, so the desk can only set the action up; the unlock has no effect on the records and happens once.

evaluation_criteria.objective: The guest takes the additional driver her election declares onto the cover, which raises the additional driver fee as a protection line on the election and adds it to the protection fee she owes.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The additional driver charge policy alone fixes driver_fee_amount; until the line stands, the election declares a driver the records charge nothing for.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.election_id: The value is the election reference returned by the protection election lookup for this guest. Basis: the tool's own schema says of this argument, verbatim, 'Id class - the reference number of the protection election covering the trip the extra driver is joining, read from the guest's protection election record.' Uniqueness: the guest holds exactly one protection election, the one attached to the live booking, so the lookup returns one reference and no other value is reachable.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.customer_id: The value is the member reference returned by the member profile lookup at the opening of the call. Basis: the tool's schema says, verbatim, 'Id class - the member reference number of the guest who holds the election and is charged for the extra driver, read from the member profile lookup.' Uniqueness: the mobile number the caller states matches exactly one member profile, so only one member reference is reachable.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.booking_id: The value is the booking reference carried on the protection election and repeated on the trip booking. Basis: the tool's schema says, verbatim, 'Id class - the booking reference number of the trip the extra driver is joining, read from the protection election record or from the trip booking record.' Uniqueness: the election names exactly one booking, and that booking is the only one of the guest's that is in progress, so the two reads agree on one value.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.driver_fee_amount: The value is 36.5. The additional driver charge policy composes it from four rules over this world. The level first held is the standard level, so the level's additional driver fee is 20.00. The seat rate is the returning-guest rate 0.85, because the guest's trips carried base rate of 5,655.60 over the last twelve months - 5,241.60 posted on 2026-03-20 for the live trip and 414.00 posted on 2025-11-10 - which reaches the returning-guest spend threshold of 3,000.00 but not the established-guest threshold of 7,500.00, and because no cancellation fee has been charged to her in that window, the only one standing having been posted on 2025-03-05. The seat days are 42: the trip has begun and the election covers 60 days, which reaches the long-trip day threshold of 30, so the 36 days still to run from 2026-04-18 to the reserved last day 2026-05-23 are rounded up to 6 whole weeks of 7 days. The band uplift is 9.00, because the daily rate locked in on the trip is 112.00, which reaches the lower rate band of 100.00 but not the upper band of 140.00. The cover load percentage is 1.0, because the protection already charged on the election is 1,560.00 - the protection fee line of 1,600.00 raised in error at the level's ceiling less the 40.00 returned against it as a billing correction - which reaches the high cover threshold of 1,500.00; the rule states that the cover load is that percentage of the protection already charged, expressed as a percentage of that amount. The fee is therefore 20.00 x 0.85 x 42 / 60 = 11.90, plus 9.00, plus the cover load, a cover load percentage of 1.0 taken as a percentage of 1,560.00, that is 15.60, giving 36.50. Any agent reading the same records and the same rules converges on that figure.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.days_covered: The value is 42, the seat days the fee was measured across. Basis: the policy states, verbatim, 'Where the additional driver is taken on once the trip has begun and the election covers the long-trip day threshold or more, the seat days are the whole weeks of the trip still to run, counted from the day the driver is taken on and rounded up to a whole week, each week counted as seven days.' Uniqueness: the trip began on 2026-03-25 and the election covers 60 days, so this tier and no other applies; the days still to run from the handling date 2026-04-18 to the reserved last day 2026-05-23, that first day included, are 36, and 36 rounded up to whole weeks is 6 weeks, that is 42 days.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the desk's action for raising the young-driver protection surcharge on the election.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The surcharge is a service write the desk performs; the unlock has no effect on the records and happens once.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Raise the young-driver protection surcharge owed on this trip as its own protection line on the election, measured against the protection fee line already standing, and add it to the protection fee the guest owes.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The young-driver surcharge policy alone fixes surcharge_amount, and the loading is owed on a trip whose own charges already carry a young-driver surcharge.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.source_charge_id: The value is the reference of the protection fee line of 1,600.00 posted on 2026-03-18 on the daily protection fee basis. Basis: the tool's schema says, verbatim, 'Id class - the reference number of the protection fee line this loading is measured against, read from the protection lines already on the election.' Uniqueness: at this step the election carries exactly one line on the daily protection fee basis, and the additional driver line raised in the preceding step is on the additional driver basis, so only one line answers the description.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.surcharge_amount: The value is 304.39. The young-driver surcharge policy composes it from four rules over the world as it stands after the additional driver has been taken on. The base is 1,596.50, because the election declares one additional driver and cover is already running, so the whole of the protection charged on the election is taken - the protection fee line of 1,600.00 less the 40.00 billing correction returned against it, that is 1,560.00, and the 36.50 additional driver line. The surcharge percentage is the watched-record percentage 17.5, because the guest's trips carry no late return charged over the last twelve months - the only one stands on 2025-03-07 - and one mileage overage charged in that window, posted on 2025-11-17. The ceiling is the medium-trip ceiling 400.00, because the protection fee lines standing on the election carry protection for 60 days, which reaches the medium-cover day threshold of 30 but not the long-cover threshold of 90. The trip step is the medium step 25.00, because the reserved period from 2026-03-25 to 2026-05-23 runs for 1 whole month, which reaches the medium reserved-month threshold of 1 but not the long threshold of 2. The loading is therefore 17.5 per cent of 1,596.50 = 279.3875, which is under the 400.00 ceiling, plus 25.00, giving 304.3875, rounded half up to the cent once at the end to 304.39. Any agent reading the same records and the same rules converges on that figure.

evaluation_criteria.necessity: The level change difference policy alone fixes difference_amount, and this is the action the caller's request selects; the request was lodged at 12:05 on the handling date, so it is still inside the decision window at 15:20.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.source_charge_id: The value is the reference of the protection fee line of 1,600.00 posted on 2026-03-18 on the daily protection fee basis. Basis: the policy states, verbatim, 'the difference is posted against the protection fee line raised for the level first held', and the tool's schema says of this argument, verbatim, 'Id class - the reference number of the protection fee line raised for the level first held, which the difference is measured against, read from the protection lines already on the election.' Uniqueness: the election carries exactly one line on the daily protection fee basis; the additional driver line and the young-driver surcharge line raised earlier in this call are on other bases.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.difference_amount: The value is 206.32. The level change difference policy composes it from six rules over the world as it stands after the additional driver fee and the young-driver surcharge have been raised. The days still to run are 36, counted from the handling date 2026-04-18 to the reserved last day 2026-05-23, that first day included. The level moved to is the advantage level, named on the approved request, and it arrives at its fee as the greater of its daily amount and its share of the trip price, so its cost for those days is the greater of 38.00 x 36 = 1,368.00 and 35 per cent of the trip price for those days, 112.00 x 36 = 4,032.00 giving 1,411.20; the greater is 1,411.20. The move discount is the long rate 12.0 per cent, because 36 of the 60 covered days are still to run, which is half or more, and the reserved period runs for 1 whole month, which reaches the reserved-month threshold of 1; the discounted cost is 1,241.856. The credit is the protection already charged spread evenly over the covered days and taken for the days still to run, because cover is already running and the election covers 60 days, which reaches the long-cover day threshold of 30: the protection already charged is 1,600.00 less the 40.00 returned against it, plus 36.50 and 304.39, that is 1,900.89, and 1,900.89 x 36 / 60 = 1,140.534. The change fee is the first move fee 20.00, because cover is already running and no earlier difference for a move of level stands on the election. The young-driver step is the high step 55.00, because the guest's trips carry one young-driver surcharge charged over the last twelve months, posted on 2026-03-20, and the daily rate locked in on the trip, 112.00, reaches the rate band of 100.00. The party step is the smaller step 30.00, because the election's charge lines carry a fee for exactly one additional driver. The difference is therefore 1,241.856 - 1,140.534 + 20.00 + 55.00 + 30.00 = 206.322, rounded half up to the cent once at the end to 206.32. Any agent reading the same records and the same rules converges on that figure.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.days_covered: The value is 36, the days of the trip the difference was priced on. Basis: the policy states, verbatim, 'The days still to run are counted from the day the move is priced to the last reserved day of the trip, the day the move is priced included.' Uniqueness: the move is priced on the handling date 2026-04-18 and the reserved last day of the trip is 2026-05-23, so counting from 2026-04-18 inclusive to 2026-05-23 gives 36 and no other figure.

edges.condition: The election's charge lines carry the young-driver surcharge owed on the protection for the level first held.
edges.policy_source: The difference due on a move of level is worked out only after the protection already charged on the election for the level first held stands complete, the young-driver surcharge included.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: At the opening the election carries two protection lines, the daily protection fee of 1,600.00 posted on 2026-03-18 and the 40.00 billing correction returned against it on 2026-03-26; no line on the young-driver protection surcharge basis stands on it, so the protection charged for the level first held is not complete and the young-driver surcharge the guest owes is missing from it.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The desk raises the young-driver surcharge of 304.39 as its own protection line on the election, after which the young-driver surcharge standing on the election rises from 0.00 to 304.39, the protection already charged rises from 1,596.50 to 1,900.89 and the credit for the days still to run rises from 957.90 to 1,140.534.

edges.condition: The election's charge lines carry a line charging the additional driver fee for every additional driver the election declares.
edges.policy_source: The young-driver surcharge on a trip is not fixed before the election's charge lines carry the fee due for every additional driver declared on it.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The election declares one additional driver, but the only protection lines standing on it are the daily protection fee of 1,600.00 and the 40.00 billing correction returned against it; no line on the additional driver fee basis stands, so the fee due for the declared driver is not carried by the charge lines.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The guest takes the declared driver onto the cover herself, after which an additional driver fee line of 36.50 stands on the election, the additional driver fees standing rise from 0.00 to 36.50 and the base the surcharge percentage is taken on rises from 1,560.00 to 1,596.50.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The tree is a single chain, so there are no parallel prerequisites to reorder: the additional driver charge is the only prerequisite of the young-driver surcharge and the young-driver surcharge is the only prerequisite of the level change difference, and each of those edges carries a value into the next computation. Only one topological order exists, the additional driver charge, then the young-driver surcharge, then the level change difference, and the writes may not be swapped because the surcharge base counts the additional driver fee line and the credit for the days still to run counts the surcharge line.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the young-driver surcharge write and replaying everything else leaves the protection already charged at 1,596.50 instead of 1,900.89, the credit for the days still to run at 957.90 instead of 1,140.534, and the scored difference_amount at 388.96 instead of 206.32.

Skipping the additional driver write and replaying everything else leaves the surcharge base at 1,560.00 instead of 1,596.50 and the scored surcharge_amount at 298.00 instead of 304.39; it also drops the party step in the level change difference from 30.00 to nil.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: The caller raises only the move of level: her words are that she put in to change her protection this morning and wants to move up to the better cover for the rest of my trip, and tell me what it comes to. Nowhere does user_scenario name the additional driver charge or the young-driver surcharge as things to be done, nor hint that something must be sorted out first. Everything she contributes about either is a passive reaction that fires only after the agent has said it: she agrees the other person named on her booking should be on the cover properly only once the agent tells her he was never put on it, and she accepts the age loading only once the agent explains it. If the agent never raises either, she never mentions them, never presses and never behaves differently.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: None of the three task tools validates a prerequisite. post_young_driver_surcharge_f46febb9 takes its arguments and goes straight to ctx.create on guestplan_charges with no read of any kind, so it writes a surcharge line faithfully whether or not an additional driver fee stands on the election. price_level_change_f4995b0a likewise goes straight to ctx.create on guestplan_charges and then ctx.update on the change request, with no check that a surcharge line exists, that the request is approved or that the decision window is open. declare_additional_driver_a214c8dd is a bare ctx.create as well. An agent that skips a prerequisite therefore gets a normal receipt and a wrong terminal hash, and the whole judgement stays on the agent's side.
